messages:
Maria Gonzalez: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem — two regressions slipped through our canary. We need concrete owners and short timelines for rollout safety improvements.
Ajay Singh: I'm happy to own auto-rollback. Planning: implement threshold-based rollback + test harness. ETA: EOW for prototype.
Olivia Chan: I'll take blast-radius controls and flag gating. Proposal: enforce initial traffic cap per-flag + ramp policy.
Samir Patel: I'll add long-running queries to detect recurring patterns (daily regression job + alert). Need schema for new metrics.
Kelly Wu: I'll update the postmortem doc and the runbook with owners/timelines. Also will schedule a weekly 30m follow-up for next 6 weeks.
Maria Gonzalez: Thanks — concretize as action items here so we don't lose them. Also want an explicit canary sampling check to detect correlation across recent deploys.
Ajay Singh: Quick note on rollback rules I'm thinking: trigger on sustained error-rate + p95 latency. We should prefer pause-and-investigate for borderline cases.
Olivia Chan: Suggested rollout snippet (for ops):

```yaml
rollout_policy:
  stages: [0.01, 0.05, 0.25, 1.0]
  monitor:
    error_rate: 
      threshold: 1.0 # percent
      window: 120s
      action: rollback
    p95_latency:
      threshold_ms: 500
      window: 300s
      action: pause
  max_blast_radius_per_flag: 0.01 # fraction of org traffic
```

Samir Patel: That looks good. For detection, I'll add two saved queries: "canary_error_spike" and "canary_regression_pattern" and a dashboard. Will post queries here once done.
Kelly Wu: Owner matrix for the doc: Ajay -> auto-rollback, Olivia -> blast-radius/flags, Samir -> telemetry/dashboards, Kelly -> doc/runbook + follow-ups. ETA matrix: prototype by Fri, tests by next Tue, rollout policy baked by next Wed.
Maria Gonzalez: I'll raise a small PR to the rollout guardrails repo to include a template flag config and require "max_blast_radius" on new flags.
Ajay Singh: One implementation detail — auto-rollback should call an idempotent API: `/flags/{flag}/pause-rollout` instead of direct toggle, to preserve signal.
deploy-bot: Reminder set: weekly follow-up meeting created for "postmortem rollout safety" on Mon 10:00 for 6 weeks.
Olivia Chan: One more ask — add a low-noise experiment that runs a 0.5% deterministic sampling over time to build a longer-term baseline for these regressions. That will help reduce false positives.
Samir Patel: Noted. I'll include a historical baseline job and backfill last 30 days.
Kelly Wu: I'll put all action items into the postmortem checklist with owners + dates and link to the PRs. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: when you've filed your first PR.
Ajay Singh: Filed draft PR for auto-rollback prototype: https://git.redwood/ri/rollout-guardrails/pulls/112 (WIP).
Olivia Chan: Filed draft PR for flag schema + max_blast_radius requirement: https://git.redwood/ri/flags/pulls/58 (WIP).
Samir Patel: Saved dashboard + queries posted in #eng-observability once I'm done. Will ping this thread with links.
Maria Gonzalez: Great. If anyone hits blockers, ping me. Let's aim to close the high-priority items within 2 sprints.
Kelly Wu: Adding checklist to postmortem now. Will update thread with final ETA table. :white_check_mark:
Maria Gonzalez: Closing note — we agreed to treat recurring patterns as first-class owners (not "someone else"), rotate responsibility monthly. That should help reduce regressions over time.
Ajay Singh: Agreed.
Olivia Chan: Agreed.
Samir Patel: Agreed.
Kelly Wu: Agreed.
Maria Gonzalez: Thanks all — meeting adjourned.
